description: Rows of a database, filtered by where (checked against the columns first), sorted, with the columns asked for. Each row is its id, its title and its non-empty columns as plain values. A relation lists its first 25 pages here (truncated names it); read_page lists them all. nextCursor reads on; Notion stops one query at 10,000 rows (incomplete says so). Works on the Free plan, unlike the hosted connector's SQL query.

account.description: Workspace: a label list_accounts names ("*": every one). Rarely needed: an id or URL finds its own.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, exactly as it came back, to read on.

database.description: The database: its id, its Notion URL, or the dataSourceId search returned for it.

in_trash.description: Rows in Notion's trash instead of the live ones.

limit.description: Rows to return; more than 100 are read 100 at a time.

match.description: Whether a row must meet all the conditions in where, or any of them.

notion_filter.description: Notion's own filter object, for what where cannot say (nested and/or, rollups). ANDed with where when both are given.

properties.description: The columns to return, by name; the title always comes back. Default: all.

sort.description: The order, first key first. Default: Notion's (the database's own order).

source.description: Which table, only when the database holds several (describe_database lists them): its name or id.

where.description: Conditions on the columns, e.g. [{"property": "Status", "op": "equals", "value": "In progress"}]. The column type comes from the schema.

op.description: Text: equals, does_not_equal, contains, does_not_contain, starts_with, ends_with. Number: equals, does_not_equal, greater_than, less_than, greater_than_or_equal_to, less_than_or_equal_to. Checkbox: equals. Select and status: equals, does_not_equal (one option or a list: any of them). Multi-select: contains, does_not_contain. Date: equals, before, after, on_or_before, on_or_after, or with no value this_week, past_week, past_month, past_year, next_week, next_month, next_year. Relation: contains (a page id). People, created by, edited by: contains, does_not_contain (a name, an email, a user id, or "me"). Any column: is_empty, is_not_empty.

value.description: What to compare with. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, an ISO date-time, or today, tomorrow, yesterday, one_week_ago, one_week_from_now, one_month_ago, one_month_from_now.

name: query_database
title: Query a database
